name: Orshom Brong

facts.text: Level 80, 30,000 health, linked with Orylle. Takes no damage except Cold damage.
Spawns Orshom's Fire; at 50% health he draws the room onto himself.
That he swallowed the hall's hearth-fire is Living Server writing built on the cold-only immunity.

story:
Orshom Brong was the biggest of the thrawn ogres who followed Orylle up from the seams, and on the night Krondon fell he put his face into the great hearth of the deepest hall and drank the fire. The ogres tell it as a boast. Whatever happened, he has burned inside ever since, and no flame or blade troubles him now. Only cold reaches what is left of him. He stands at the queen's shoulder and fights when she fights, and when he is half spent the fire in him flares, he roars, and the whole room turns to him.

The night of the hearth. Orshom Brong was the largest of the ogres who followed Orylle up from the seams, and on the night Krondon fell he walked into the deepest hall where the great hearth burned, the fire the hall-folk had kept alight since their founding, and put his face into it and drank. The ogres tell it as a boast; the ghosts tell it as a grief, because that hearth was the hall's oldest keeping and its hyrde the most honoured of all.

What it made him. He has burned inside ever since. Fire passes through him and steel finds nothing to cut; only cold reaches what is left of him, as if the hearth inside him were the only real thing and frost the only thing that can quench it. He stands at Orylle's shoulder, her champion and her consort, and fights when she fights, and when he is half spent the fire in him flares and the whole room turns to him. Sometimes the fire spills out of him and burns on the floor of its own accord. The cold casters of Albion's raids are the only ones who have ever made him afraid.
legend:
Nothing hurts him but cold. Bring ice wizards, cold-damage casters, anything frosty, and put them on him and only him. At half health he pulls the room; healers be ready. He and Orylle go down together or the raid goes down.

Bring at least six cold-damage casters and keep them on him alone. When the fire leaves him and burns on the floor, move out of it. At half health he pulls the room: healers stand ready, tanks hold their own targets. Fire wizards can still help: put them on Orylle while the ice-mages work on Orshom. The old guides said the two must fall close together, so pace the damage and do not kill one far ahead of the other.

loremasterTopic.text: He drank the hearth-fire of Krondon's deepest hall, the ogres boast, and has burned within ever since. Fire and steel are nothing to him. Only cold. He stands beside Orylle; they fall together.

bookPage: On the night Krondon fell, the ogres say, Orshom Brong walked into the deepest hall and put his face into the great hearth and drank it. The ghosts of the hall tell the same story with different words, because that fire had been kept alight since the founding, and its keeper was the most honoured hyrde of all. Whatever happened, Orshom burns within to this day. Our fire wizards might as well have thrown flowers. Our ice-mages put him out, slowly, the way you put out a peat fire, and when he fell the hall grew cold for the first time in a hundred years.
